To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the okra genotypes IC331217,IC332453 and IC 342075 and cultivar Arka Anamaka are the most suitable genotypes/cultivar to be grown in the field for obtaining higher yield of fruits.
the genotypes viz., ICH 31117, ICH 332453 and ICH 342075 and cultivar viz., Manisha 211 and Arka Annamika were found to be resistant to whitefly, aphids and leafhoppers as well as YVMV disease.

the okra genotypes, viz., IC3312 17, IC332453, IC342075 and okra cultivars, viz., Manisha 211 and Arka anamika were found to be least preferred over other genoty p es/cultivars to whiteflies, aphid and leafhoppers and were found to be tolerant to Yellow vein mosaic virus.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of okra genotypes that are resistant or tolerant to whitefly, aphids, leafhopper and YVMV disease.
the identification of resistant genotypes/cultivar against sucking pests as well as YVMV disease under field conditions.
the identification of okra genotypes that can be used for developing whitefly resistant varieties.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the genotype IC342075 and IC331217 and cultivar Manisha-211 are recommended for cultivation in the okra growing areas of the country.
the genotype IC332453 was found to be the best in the present study, as it recorded the lowest incidence of whitefly, aphid, leafhoppers and YVMV disease as well as higher fruit yields.
the okra genotypes, IC331217, 332453 and 342075 and cultivar, Arka Anamkia were found to be highly resistant to sucking pests and yellow vein mosaic virus disease.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

these four genotypes/cultivar viz., IC331207, IC332453, IC342075, Manisha-211, and Arka Animika could be considered as the best okra genotypes for the production of okra under the prevailing agro-climatic conditions in the region of the present study.
the genotypes viz., Manisha, IC331217 and IC342075 are highly resistant to sucking pests and YVMV disease.

the genotypes viz.,IC331217, IC331217, and IC342075 along with the cultivars viz., IC331218 and Manisha-211 could be considered as potential okra genotypes to be used for breeding programme against sucking pest and YVMV disease.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the genotypes viz. IC331217, and IC332453 and cultivars viz. Manisha-211, and Arka Anammika can be recommended to growers for commercial cultivation.
the genotypes/cultivar IC331217, 332453 and 342075, and Manisha-211, Arka Anamikas are promising in respect to sucking pest and YVMV disease resistance and fruit yields.

IC331217,IC332453 and IC 342075, Manisha-211 & Arka Anamica could be considered as potential genotypes/cultivar for further evaluation under field conditions for developing okra varieties resistant to sucking pests and YVMV disease.
